name: Salary converted into a bAV (Entgeltumwandlung)
workings: 3,000 of salary paid into a bAV: within 8% of the pension ceiling (8,112) tax-free, and within 4% (4,056) free of contributions
Contributions on 57,000: pension 5,301.00, unemployment 741.00, health 4,987.50, care 1,368.00
The employer adds 15% of the converted salary: 450, credited to the bAV
The pension credit is on 57,000: converted salary earns no points
